name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Rotisserie Half Chicken, Smoked Turkey or Pulled Pork with Mashed Potatoes & Cornbread
brandOrRestaurant: Boardwalk BBQ (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Boardwalk BBQ is arguably the cleanest quick-service kitchen inside Knott's Berry Farm: slow-roasted rotisserie half chicken, smoked turkey breast, or pulled pork served with whipped mashed potatoes and a soft cornbread muffin!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Rotisserie Half Chicken** (remove the seasoned skin) or **Smoked Pulled Pork / Turkey** (no BBQ sauce) with **Mashed Potatoes** and the warm **Cornbread Muffin** (verify no whole corn kernels).
watchOuts: Take a lactase tablet for the mashed potatoes and ask for all BBQ sauces on the side
